hero.filename: Manuel Lopez Lopez - Fue muerta y destroiada nel campo esta infelir p. haver resistido alos deseos brutales de los negros y el niño pererio de hambre asulado buscando el becho yerto desu madre.jpg
hero.caption:
Engraving by Manuel López López used to illustrate a hostile biography of Jean-Jacques Dessalines : Vida de J. J. Dessalines, gefe de los negros de Santo Domingo, 1806.
The French pamphleteer Louis Dubroca (1757-1835), an admirer of Napoleon, sought to use these works to depreciate fighters of color in the eyes of the metropolitan public[1].

images.filename: Manuel Lopez Lopez Iodibo - Desalines - Huyes del valor frances, pero matando blancos.jpg
images.caption: Entitled simply Desalines, it depicts the general, sword raised in one arm, while the other holds a severed head of a white colonist woman. Engraving made by Manuel López López to illustrate the book of bonapartist pamphleteer Louis Dubroca, 1806.
